data.name: Ankush
data.gender_notes: Ankush is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: A goad; a hook for elephants
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit aṅkuśa, 'a goad, an elephant hook'. Its root is Sanskrit aṅkuśa (अङ्कुश). A classical Sanskrit term for an elephant goad. Ankush is a Sanskrit name meaning “A goad; a hook for elephants”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ankush expresses “A goad; a hook for elephants”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit aṅkuśa, 'a goad, an elephant hook'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ankush total 20, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.
